title.zh: 声音从振动来 · 米粒会跳的鼓
title.en: Sound from Vibration · A Drum with Jumping Rice

description.zh: 声音由物体振动产生：振幅决定强度，频率决定音高，需要介质传播，速度随介质不同。鼓面运动为示意的衰减简谐运动。
description.en: Sound comes from an object's vibration: amplitude sets intensity, frequency sets pitch, a medium is needed, and speed depends on the medium. The drumhead motion is an illustrative decaying oscillation.

reason.zh: 鼓面来回运动并逐渐衰减，可以用振幅、频率描述，这正是振动（振子）的基本量。
reason.en: The drumhead moves back and forth and gradually dies away; amplitude and frequency describe it, the basic quantities of an oscillation.
